title: WHO GOOGLE
*PUTS ON*
THE MAP
slides.sub: Google's own three reasons, in plain English.

title: THREE GET
*THE MAP*
slides.body: Search "plumber near me". Three businesses get the map. Everyone else gets scrolled past.

title: DO YOU MATCH
*THE SEARCH?*
slides.body: Google checks your category, services and description against what people typed. Wrong boxes, wrong searches.

title: HOW CLOSE
*ARE YOU?*
slides.body: You can't move your shop. You can set your service areas properly, so Google knows where you work.

title: HOW WELL
*KNOWN ARE YOU?*
slides.body: Your reviews, your website, other sites mentioning you. Google weighs all of it.

title: YOU CAN'T BUY
*A BETTER SPOT*
slides.body: Google says there's no way to pay for a better local ranking. You earn it, steadily.

title: FIX THIS
*FIRST*
slides.body: Fill in every part of your Google Business Profile: category, services, areas, hours, photos of real jobs.

title: WANT A
*FREE AUDIT?*
slides.body: Comment GOOGLE below or send us a message, and I'll check your Google profile for free.
